Name: Aesthetic Secret Notes
Author: Wakasagihime99
Description:
[b]CONTENTS[/b]
- New secret notes icon.
﻿- mild beautification / improved secret notes icon visual effect.
﻿- 3 different colors themes.

[b]INSTRUCTION[/b]
- Requirement: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Content Patcher[/url].
- Extract to \Stardew Vally\Mods\.
- Open config.json and change the images you prefer. (I personally recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod to edit config file in game.)
- Use SMAPI to run the game .

[b]NOTIFICATION[/b]
- Some of the UI interfaces are from: [url=https://blog.naver.com/ssm4031/222130321865]https://blog.naver.com/ssm4031/222130321865[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11338]Citrus Interface[/url].
- This is my first trial, please contact me if you have any issue with the mod.
